name: ProgressCircle
summary: Show determinate or indeterminate progress in a compact circular indicator.

useWhen: Showing completion for a task with a known or unknown progress value.
avoidWhen: For long-running activity without a meaningful completion measure or for linear comparisons.
When the loading transition itself must be announced without a separate status or live region.

obligations: Provide an accessible name with a Label part, label shorthand, or aria-label/aria-labelledby.
Clamps determinate values to the min/max range and exposes accessible progress values.
Indeterminate progress omits aria-valuenow and aria-valuetext.
A progressbar does not announce loading transitions by itself; pair it with a separate status or live region when an announcement is required.

behavior: Root forwards refs to the native HTMLDivElement progressbar and Track renders an aria-hidden SVG.
label is a plain aria-label shorthand when no explicit aria-label or aria-labelledby is supplied; explicit names take precedence, and supplying label with Label chooses the shorthand.
Clamps determinate values to the min/max range and exposes accessible progress values.
Indeterminate progress treats null, undefined, and non-finite values as unknown and omits aria-valuenow and aria-valuetext.
size selects 32px, 48px, or 64px Track dimensions; use Track className for a local compact size and motion policy because there is no built-in 16px size.
Indeterminate progress uses the Mux rotate and dash motion recipe; prefers-reduced-motion and a data-reduced-motion or data-muxui-motion="reduced" ancestor settle both animations.
accessibility: Expose a named progressbar through Label, label, aria-label, or aria-labelledby; when label is supplied with Label, the shorthand aria-label is used. A Track-only composition is decorative and does not provide progress semantics.
Expose determinate aria-valuenow and aria-valuetext while leaving those attributes absent for indeterminate progress.
Progressbar semantics convey state and value but do not replace a status or live announcement for loading transitions.

requirements.reason: Native dynamic colors do not apply to the React web binding.
Native font metrics do not apply to the React web binding.
